reason: A more clearly advances beyond prior work by coupling shear-induced surface nanostructuring with repassivation and testing combined, wear-only, and corrosion-related responses against a matched baseline, including a mediator-specific falsification test and activation boundaries. B is largely a direct restatement of the cited boron/TiB2 study and does not adequately separate the wear, corrosion, and interaction components of tribocorrosion.
